verdict.rationale: cubic's built-in AI can be tagged as @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments to answer questions, trigger reviews or an Ultrareview, and fix issues. Its 'Fix with cubic' button and coding-agent integration generate fixes in the background and push them to the PR branch. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that delegated fixes work in practice, and delegation beyond review, fix and Q&A tasks (the in-product AI sidebar for broader Q&A appears only in archived docs).
